source: The 2026-11-18 navego.pages.dev rebrand and consistency pass: logo, wordmark, eyebrows, type and spacing system, nav notch, copy pass. User direction arrived 2026-11-18; internet sources were verified 2026-11-18. Repo sources point at the docs that already carry the decision.
note: One decision, one source. Code references this file as `decisions.json → D<n>`. A decision the user asked for carries kind=user; a decision nobody asked for carries the internet source it was taken from; a decision inherited from this repo carries the repo document that already carries it.

decisions.decision: The body text is 14 px on every page.
The type scale uses even pixel steps only: 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 24, 28, 32, 40, 64.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'jika misalnya heading 1 heading 2 dan seterusnya gunakan ukuran genap dan konsisten'

decisions.decision: h1 is 40 px (hero 64 px on /beranda, 28 px on ≤860 px), h2 is 28 px, h3 is 20 px, h4 is 18 px.
Line heights are unitless: display 1.1, heading 1.25, body 1.5, small 1.4.
Running text meets the 1.5 line-height floor so it survives visitor overrides.
Text fills the width of its container; no 18ch/44ch/46ch/66ch/68ch/72ch measure caps anywhere.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'lebarnya full bukan yang terpotong di tengah' and the follow-up option 'Konten tidak dibatasi terlalu sempit'
source.also: https://practicaltypography.com/line-length.html (45-90 characters, the rule this overrides by owner decision)

decisions.decision: Text is flush left; horizontal centering is kept only for symmetric fixed-box icons and figures.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'alignment mana yang harus alignment kiri mana yang harus tengah semua harus konsisten'

decisions.decision: Paragraph → paragraph spacing is 1 em.
A heading gets more space above (32 px, larger than paragraph spacing, so it stands out) and less below (12 px, smaller than paragraph spacing, so it bonds to its text).
The spacing scale is multiples of 4 px: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 72, 104.
The gutter is 20 px, 32 px at ≥940 px — one fixed even step each, no fractional vw.

source.ref: https://material.io/design/layout/spacing-methods.html (4-px base unit, both values sit on the grid)

decisions.decision: Body/UI type is Tahoma, Verdana, system-ui; mono is Lucida Console — the zero-download system stack the Y2K house face ships.

source.ref: docs/design-elements.md (Corporate Y2K done flat: cream ground, deep navy ink, one amber accent)

decisions.decision: Display type is Arial Black, weight 900, letter-spacing -0.02em.
Ground is cream #f6f1e7, ink is navy-deep #0d1338, the one warm accent is amber #d8923f.
Amber is the single warm accent; everything else stays in the navy/cream system.
:focus-visible carries a 3 px outline, 3 px offset; on navy surfaces the ring goes amber.
Buttons hold a 44 px minimum block size.
Button padding is 12 px × 24 px; small button 8 px × 16 px; chips 4 px × 12 px — even pixel steps on the 4-px grid.
Radius steps stay even and few: 14 px panels, 10 px controls.

source.ref: https://material.io/design/layout/spacing-methods.html (4-px base unit, both values are multiples of 2)

decisions.decision: Flat surfaces carry no shadows; the one floating element (the nav notch) carries the one shadow and the one gradient on the site.

source.also: user 2026-11-18 (the notch redesign with its effect)

decisions.decision: The nav notch is always visible at every width; compact widths collapse the flat row into it; hover or focus drops the full link strip; amber glow on hover/focus is the effect; the chevron turns amber with it.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'tampilkan notch di semua lebar layar kemudian redesign bentuk notch menjadi modern dan memiliki efek'

decisions.decision: The sticky header hides while scrolling down and returns on the way up; it stays put while focused.
Numbers in tables align right and use tabular figures; body text stays left.
prefers-reduced-motion disables smooth scrolling and transitions.
text-wrap: balance on headings, pretty on prose.
The footer hands out an 88x31 badge; the size is the early-web link-back convention.
The header hides via a container scroll-state query so it does not depend on JS.
The mark is one hand-drawn stroke: left stem, the diagonal (top-left to bottom-right), right stem, each with a slight human bow — never ruler-straight.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: pick D, fix the reversed stroke direction, then 'buat huruf N pada logo lebih natural seperti coretan manusia'

decisions.decision: The amber underline below the N is one symmetric arc, centred on 120.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'betulkan juga garis stroke di bawahnya agar simetris'

decisions.decision: The wordmark is the same hand: single-stroke round-capped letters, one motion per glyph, no tittle over the g.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'kata navego buat jadi tulisan tangan'; 'di atas huruf g tidak perlu ada titik'; 'tulisan tangan navego buat konsisten untuk stylenya'

decisions.decision: The letters a and e are drawn to read unmistakably (closed bowl plus stem for a; loop plus crossbar for e) — a wordmark nobody can read is decoration, not a wordmark.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'huruf a dan e masih belum bisa terbaca'

decisions.decision: One mark everywhere: components, favicon (icon.svg), standalone mark (navego-mark.svg), 88x31 badge, og-cover.
The mark palette is fixed: disc #233259, stroke #f4f1e9, accent #d8923f (badge uses the reversed navy-on-cream form).

source.ref: docs/design-elements.md (navy disc, chrome, amber accent); site/app/components/NavegoMark.tsx (current art)

decisions.decision: No Huginn & Muninn anywhere; the footer line is 'Navego — Browser Anda, atas perintah Anda.' and the auth panel carries the logo lockup, not a myth label.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'ganti huginn & muninn dengan navego dan logonya'

decisions.decision: No eyebrows, kickers or crumbs above headings, anywhere — the heading is the first thing on the page.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18 (beranda screenshot, then 'hapus semua eyebrows no eyebrows')

decisions.decision: The document outline runs h1 → h2 → body; nothing sits above the h1.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'agentik browser lokal ada di atas heading satu yang mana itu tidak urut'
source.also: https://design-system.canada.ca/en/styles/typography (heading levels numerically ordered, no skipped levels)

decisions.decision: The middle dot is never used as a separator — commas, dashes or parentheses instead.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'pemisah tidak boleh menggunakan titik tengah'

decisions.decision: The login panel opens with the logo lockup, not a label; the h1 stays 'Masuk atau daftar.' in the same place on both phases of the form.
